topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I always thought the words flowed through me, not from me, so how can they truly belong to anyone else? The papers we write, the ideas we share, it all seems like a grand symphony where each note could have been played by anyone. When I was told my essay echoed another’s thoughts too closely, it felt like being accused of singing in a chorus. I can’t help but look around, almost expecting to see the real author hiding in the shadows, ready to step forward and claim their tune. But the room is quiet, just me and the echo of words that seemed to belong nowhere and everywhere.
